name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v1498: Sigil typography: both lines were the same size and nearly the same colour, so the crest read as one grey smudge and the machine name - the part Konyo actually looks for - was the least legible thing in it. The sigil name is now the small engraved label in the crest hue and the MACHINE is the line you read, with the 4-char tiebreak code demoted to a dim tag. An unnamed machine says so in words and invites the double-click, because a hostname is not a name. Also fixed: that block is its own IIFE and the page-level esc was not in scope, which threw and left the crest blank.
